subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics integration and state management: wheel-space transform chain and body-motion state (VehiclePhysicsTick), per-frame setup-vector propagation (VehicleSetupDataCopy), climb/vibration adjustment (VehicleClimbAdjust), yaw-recovery state machine, dynamics state reset, lerped state propagation, proximity evaluation, plus vehicle/engine/damage/brake/tire configuration parsers used during .hdv and setup file loading.

summary: Proposed VehiclePhysics subsystem reconstructed from sixteen validated functions. A per-vehicle runtime state object (GUESS, owner unconfirmed in packet) carries the wheel-space transform state: the 3x3 orientation matrix at +0x34B0..+0x34D0, setup/wheel vectors at +0x34D4..+0x350C and +0x3534..+0x3548, body-motion state at +0xFE4..+0xFF8, climb/vibration fields at +0x3994..+0x39C4, per-wheel data at +0x35B0 (62-dword stride, four entries) and the physics-mode selector at +0x32BC. VehiclePhysicsTick dispatches on that selector (cases 0-3) and is the per-frame integration hub; VehicleSetupDataCopy feeds it from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep; VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine and VehicleDynamicsStateReset run under VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController. A shared physics buffer (dbl_7C7428) backs suspension/body-motion fallbacks. Configuration parsers (damage, engine, per-wheel brake/suspension, damping validation, engine-map field definitions) share a token-stream helper family and validate inputs with session-gated debug logging. All class ownership and field semantics are DERIVED/GUESS; only the address-level function boundaries and call relationships are packet-confirmed.

function_roles.role: Adjust vehicle climb/throttle value: when the rigid-body constraint pointer at +0x32BC is non-zero, clamp climb (+0x3994) to the minimum (+0x399C) or recompute a climb vibration level from the weather-noise ring buffer (flt_8AB274 / dword_8AAE70) into +0x39B8..; when the pointer is null, fall back to SuspensionVibration on the shared dbl_7C7428 buffer.

Transform a point by the stored 3x3 matrix (+0x34B0..+0x34D0) plus translation (+0x34D4..+0x34DC) after sampling RideHeightDelta, copy three dwords (+0x34E0..+0x34E8) into a3, and return the middle copied dword. Called from eleven sites including AIRacingLine, VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate, SessionStateTransition and VehicleYawRotationRecoveryController.

Per-frame vehicle physics update dispatched on the mode selector at +0x32BC (cases 0-3 via jpt_4F046E): integrates the wheel-space transform chain, updates HUD elements 43/44, queries body-motion state, runs per-wheel collision/suspension/vibration geometry, and triggers vehicle sound on an instance-id match; then runs SteeringForceWithRandom and, for handled modes, VehicleStateUpdate plus a 16-tick damping/flag governor.

Copy setup vectors from six sources (a2..a7) plus a 0x24-byte orientation matrix block into +0x34B0..+0x350C / +0x3534..+0x353C and compute two 3x3 matrix-vector transforms (+0x34F8..+0x3500 and +0x3540..+0x3548) for render coordinates; store a8 at +0x39F0 and return it. Called per frame from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.

Per-frame yaw-recovery state machine branching on the state dword at obj+0x4064: the non-zero path accumulates time at +0x4004 and, past a 15.0 threshold, resets counters and (session 7, audio flag +0x1051) fires an audio effect; the zero path runs off-track detection (obj+0x4170, dword_7CE814, wheel array, +0x3994) and position recovery via nearest-path lookup (sub_403640) and a lateral-distance bound test, marking +0x3D60 = 2 and emitting render/AI-tracking notifications in session 7.

Vehicle dynamics state reset: zero the nine dwords +0x34EC..+0x350C, zero the four per-wheel entries at +0x35B0 (62-dword stride), and when the enable flag +0x32BC is clear also zero the shared suspension physics buffer (dbl_7C7428); returns the per-wheel array base or the conditional call's result.

Parse the vehicle damage configuration stream: open in binary-read mode, locate the Physical subsection, and decode collision/detach/aero/random-damage parameters into a flat struct (general physics, front/rear wing, four wheels, eight detachable parts) with generated Wheel%d/Part%d keys; returns 0 on success, -1 when the stream cannot be opened. Invoked by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.
Zero a 16-element array at the object base then write a block of physics default constants through the target (DWORD indices 18..65); returns the target. Called from TireModelDataInit.

Parse per-wheel brake/suspension configuration doubles from a shared token stream (handle 384) into a double array (bump/rebound travel, bump-stop params, brake torque/wear/fade/thermal, pushrod values, Celsius-to-Kelvin brake optimum at this+0xB8), then normalize 11 range/setting pairs into the corner block (704-byte stride by wheel index) with a deg-to-rad camber multiplier. Called by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.
Zero-initializer: clear six DWORDs per iteration over six iterations from this+4, then explicitly zero +0x90..+0xA4, and return this. Called by TireModelDataInit.

Damping-direction sign validation during .hdv loading: parse three damping doubles from a token into a 24-byte triple selected by direction index (0-5) and log per-axis warnings when the damping sign opposes expected motion, suppressed in session type 5.

Engine-map field-definition registration: register three range/setting pairs (rev limit, engine map, engine braking multiplier) on the setup target via CRTMathHelper_e1f0 with RPM-scale and unit scales. Invoked by EngineSectionParser and TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

Parse the [ENGINE] section of the vehicle engine configuration: fuel/inertia, idle/launch/rev-limit (RPM converted to rad/s), the RPM-torque curve, lifetime and thermal parameters, with idle/launch/curve ordering and point-count validation logged in non-server sessions; ends with stream cleanup. Invoked by TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser.

Evaluate linear combinations of three scalar inputs against per-field coefficients and biases on the 'this' object, writing two force component magnitudes (fabs of +0x444 / +0x47C) and a combined output into a5 and a6; unconditional on the per-frame physics path.

Lerp-interpolate a base value between two prior float fields by factor a2, store it at +0xA0, then write three coefficient-scaled plus bias-adjusted outputs to +0x94/+0x98/+0x9C; returns the float bit pattern of the +0x9C output. Per-frame physics state propagation with distance/time falloff.

Compute closest-approach proximity distances from this vehicle to two target entities by projecting position+direction lines: target1 via the +0x110 pointer, target2 via the +0x114 pointer, own data via the +0x10C block; parallel directions store a sentinel, self references store 0, otherwise the smaller line distance is stored at +0xB0/+0xB4.

classes.name: Vehicle
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle runtime physics and state object (packet 'this' base): wheel-space transform matrix +0x34B0..+0x34D0, setup/wheel/velocity vectors +0x34D4..+0x350C and +0x3534..+0x3548, world position/velocity +0x10..+0x54, body-motion state +0xFE4..+0xFF8, per-wheel data +0x35B0, climb/vibration +0x3994..+0x39C4, proximity links +0x10C/0x110/0x114, recovery counters, and the physics-mode selector +0x32BC.

classes.name: VehicleBodyObject
classes.responsibility: Object reached by dereferencing this[0] (packet 'obj' base): carries the post-process input state dword (+0x4064), an off-track distance (+0x4170, FLT_MAX sentinel), a mode/lap-line field (+0x3450) and the instance id (+0x4894) used to gate the vehicle sound trigger.

classes.name: MotionLineEntity
classes.responsibility: Position+direction line object (packet bases *(this+0x10C) own data block and *(this+0x110) target1): position at +0x94/+0x9C, direction at +0xA4/+0xAC, plus an internal self pointer (+0x110) on target1. Consumed by VehicleProximity for closest-approach projection.

classes.name: ProximityTargetEntity
classes.responsibility: Second proximity target object (packet base *(this+0x114)): a different layout from the motion-line objects, exposing position at +0x0/+0x8 only. Used by VehicleProximity's target2 projection.

classes.name: VehicleDamageModel
classes.responsibility: Flat vehicle damage configuration struct populated by ParseVehicleDamageConfig: general physics, front/rear wing, four wheels and eight detachable parts. Damage parameter slots (this+0..this+132 observed) are not field-evidenced by the packet.

classes.name: EngineSetup
classes.responsibility: Engine setup configuration struct populated by ParseEngineSection with field definitions registered by EngineMapSetupFieldDefinitions: idle/launch/rev-limit RPM (rad/s), RPM-torque curve, idle throttle clamp, lifetime RPM/temperature and optimum oil temperature (+0x12C8).

classes.name: PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader
classes.responsibility: Parser object for per-wheel brake/suspension configuration (token stream to double array, then corner-block normalization). Only this+0xB8 (brake optimum temperature, Kelvin) is field-evidenced; the remaining double-array element mapping is derived from token names.

classes.name: HdvFileParser
classes.responsibility: Vehicle .hdv loading helper: validates damping-direction signs per axis (VehicleDampingDirectionValidation) with session-gated debug logging. Class identity is GUESS; no field layout is evidenced.

classes.name: TireModel
classes.responsibility: Tire model data object initialized by tireModelZeroInit and PhysicsDefaultsInitializer during TireModelDataInit: head region and trailing fields +0x90..+0xA4 are zeroed, then a block of physics default constants is written (DWORD indices 18..65, offsets not field-evidenced).

classes.name: WheelParameterEvaluator
classes.responsibility: Per-frame wheel parameter evaluator: computes linear combinations of three scalar inputs against coefficient/bias doubles (this+0x3F4..+0x530) producing two force magnitudes and a combined output. Field names and physical meaning are GUESS; the packet proves only the linear structure.

states.name: Mode0_FullUpdate
states.description: Integrate wheel-space transform chain, update HUD elements 43/44, query body motion state, run per-wheel collision/suspension geometry, trigger vehicle sound on instance-id match.

states.name: Mode1_VelocityThreshold
states.description: Velocity-threshold variant: VelocityThresholdCheck then fall through into case 2's shared integration.

states.name: Mode2_SharedIntegration_Torque
states.description: Shared integration plus wheel-torque accumulation and per-wheel suspension-parameter/vibration updates.

states.name: Mode3_DelegateTimestep
states.description: Delegate to the physics time-step for the referenced vehicle via sub_4B9AC0/VehiclePhysicsTimeStep on the vehicle array at 0x5EC6D8.

states.name: NonZero_Accumulating
states.description: State dword obj+0x4064 non-zero: accumulate frame time at this+0x4004; past 15.0 reset counters and, in session 7 with the audio flag set, fire the audio effect.

states.name: Zero_RecoveryCheck
states.description: State dword zero: off-track guard (obj+0x4170 below FLT_MAX / dword_7CE814 / wheel array / +0x3994) then nearest-path and lateral-bound recovery decision.

states.name: RecoveryTriggered
states.description: Recovery fired: reset counters, set this+0x3D60 = 2, and in session 7 emit RenderCallWithGuard + AIVehiclePathPositionTracking + StateChangeNotify.

transitions.condition: accumulator at this+0x4004 > 15.0 -> reset counters; audio effect in session 7
accumulator exceeds flt_7D0A8C and off-track and lateral distance below 7.0 / bound test fails

interfaces.name: WheelSuspensionGeometry
interfaces.purpose: Per-wheel suspension, collision, vibration and transform helper family operating on a vehicle/wheel context; used by VehiclePhysicsTick and VehicleClimbAdjust.

interfaces.name: ConfigTokenStreamParser
interfaces.purpose: Shared token-stream reading, line decoding and scalar parsing helpers plus the CRT range/setting registration routine, used by all vehicle config parsers (damage, engine, per-wheel brake/suspension, damping validation).

interfaces.name: DebugLogWriter
interfaces.purpose: Debug-log pipeline (string split plus write) used for configuration validation diagnostics gated by session type.

interfaces.name: HudAndSoundTrigger
interfaces.purpose: HUD element configuration and per-vehicle sound/audio effect triggers driven from the per-frame physics update.

compatibility_contracts.name: PerVehiclePhysicsStateLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the per-vehicle state object ('this' base) layout touched every frame: orientation matrix block +0x34B0..+0x34D0, wheel/setup vectors +0x34D4..+0x350C and +0x3534..+0x3548, world position/velocity +0x10..+0x54, body-motion state +0xFE4..+0xFF8, per-wheel data at +0x35B0 (four entries, 62-dword stride), climb/vibration +0x3994..+0x39C4, and the physics-mode selector at +0x32BC (dispatched by VehiclePhysicsTick and read by VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine, VehicleDynamicsStateReset and VehicleClimbAdjust).

compatibility_contracts.name: SharedPhysicsBufferAndRegistry
compatibility_contracts.description: dbl_7C7428 is the shared suspension/body-motion physics object read and reset by VehicleClimbAdjust, VehicleDynamicsStateReset and VehiclePhysicsTick; dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC] selects the active vehicle whose instance id (obj+0x4894) gates the sound trigger; dword_7C8B44/0x7C8B48 are reset before the trigger.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleStateArrayStride
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle state array rooted at global 0x5EC6D8 is indexed by the vehicle index field (this+0x4) with a 18624-byte (0x48C0) stride during VehiclePhysicsTick case-3 delegation to VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionTypeGatedDiagnostics
compatibility_contracts.description: Debug warnings during configuration load are suppressed when session type dword_7C569C == 5 (server), and recovery/audio notifications require dword_7C56A4 == 7; these globals gate diagnostic and notification side effects and must keep their semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: HudElement43_44Contract
compatibility_contracts.description: VehiclePhysicsTick emits HUDElementConfig(43/44,...) each handled frame driven by the flags this+0x4018 (element 43) and this+0x401C (element 44, scaled by dbl_7C7598*4 clamped to 1.0); a replacement must reproduce these HUD updates or accept missing HUD output.

compatibility_contracts.name: DampingGovernorSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: After each handled physics mode, the damping governor recomputes this+0x105B from v75 = 0.94 - this+0x1030*0.9 against globals flt_8AFECC/8AFEE8/8AFEEC every 16 ticks (counter this+0x4020); external pokes to +0x105B do not persist because the field is recomputed.

unresolved: Class ownership is GUESS: the packet declares UnknownObject owners for eight of the sixteen functions; grouping them into a single Vehicle class (plus VehicleBodyObject for the 'obj' base reached via this[0]) is worker synthesis, not packet-proven common ownership.

The 'this' base offsets 0x94..0xA0 appear on both Vehicle (motion outputs, per physics functions) and TireModel (zero-init region). The packet does not prove these are the same object, so they are kept as distinct field identities per rule 8.

VehiclePhysicsTick reads twelve float/double constants (flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E444, flt_59E450, flt_59E46C, flt_59E670, flt_59E824, dbl_59ED28, flt_5ACD48, flt_5ACDC0, flt_5AD164, flt_5AD180) that do not appear directly in the raw source; their roles are unknown and they are carried in unresolved_evidence_refs.

The config-token string globals (0x005D4E90..0x005D572C) are read by the parse functions as Wheel%d/Part%d key templates and scalar tokens whose text content is not recovered in the packet; the exact token-to-offset mapping is DERIVED from the operation prose and unconfirmed.

Unreferenced-by-body globals dbl_5AD278/5AD280 (VehicleProximity epsilon candidates), flt_59E43C (PropagateLerpedPhysicsState), and dword_5EB978/0x008ACEE0 (VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine) plus the VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine flt_59E84C/59E864/59E8D8/59EAE0 and dbl_59E420/59EA38/59EAC8/5AD258 (ParseEngineSection constant candidates) are listed by the IDB but absent from the decompiled bodies; they are carried in unresolved_evidence_refs.
VehicleYawRecoveryStateMachine status flags v8/v9 and v22/v23 are read without a visible assignment (Hex-Rays artifacts); the comparisons that set them are unresolved.

The SuspensionVibration fallback called by VehicleClimbAdjust and the suspension state-zeroing routine named in VehicleDynamicsStateReset's raw source are not in the packet callee lists; their addresses are unverified.

TransformPointByMatrix matrix layout (row-major vs column-major at +0x34B0..+0x34D0), the meaning of the 3-dword copy into a3 and the returned a3[1], and the behavior of RideHeightDelta are not recoverable from this packet.
PhysicsDefaultsInitializer reads v1 before assignment; the literal write target (DWORD indices 18..65, ~192 bytes) is ambiguous and its byte offsets are not field-evidenced.
LoadPerWheelBrakeSuspensionData's 704-byte corner-block stride and offsets 176..816 are observed from the body but not packet field-evidenced; a3 is unused in the visible body.
VehicleDampingDirectionValidation's six force-apply log strings and section token are referenced by address only; their text content is not recovered and dbl_59E430 as a 0.0 sentinel is DERIVED.
EngineMapSetupFieldDefinitions/ParseEngineSection target pointers at this+5488/+5552/+5616 have no field evidence refs; the layout they index is not defined here.
VehicleProximity writes the large float sentinel 2139095039 at +0xB4 for the non-self parallel case only in raw source beyond the packet truncation; the sentinel value is not a packet field.
evaluateLinearVehicleParameters output written through a6 is computed but never read inside the function; its downstream consumer is not in the packet.
